title: AudioRetrievalManifest
description: Per-cue retrieved audio assets aligned with audio_cues_plan. Pure domain data; frontend renders the array as an audio-cue list (each item has an audio_url so the user can audition).

title.description: Cue description (same text as audio_cues_plan.cues[].title) — what the asset is supposed to sound like.

audio_url.description: CDN URL of the retrieved asset (auto audio player).

target_duration.description: Target length in seconds requested from the retrieval.

actual_duration.description: Actual length of the retrieved asset.

retrieval_status.description: Outcome of the Phase 04a prep step. Renders as a badge chip.

prepared_path.description: Local prepared path (e.g. trimmed/resampled) for Phase 05 mix.
